gate_kinds.physics-level: GATE-L1, GATE-L2 and GATE-L3 open a paper physics level; they stay closed until their typed manifest is accepted.
gate_kinds.numerical-campaign: Admits one accepted, preregistered numerical campaign about a declared component model (the collisionless test-particle wall-loss campaign on one qualified field; the robust multi-objective optimisation campaign on the L0 model under the declared closure CL-1). It opens no physics level (opens_level is null), must be accepted (never closed), and its manifest is cross-checked against the sealed results bundle, the hash-bound evidence file, the bound section and the claim matrix by a campaign-specific checker in check_paper.py.
gate_kinds.numerical-screening: Admits one preregistered, single-execution L1a field-only screening study (linear-vacuum equivalent-current fields; no permanent-magnet or nonlinear-iron material model) at exactly its recorded outcome, declared as recorded_outcome: accepted-screening, preregistered-null or recorded-characterization. The gate status accepted means the study is admitted as recorded, never that a positive finding is accepted; a null is admitted as a null under the frozen definitions and is not an existence disproof. It opens no physics level (opens_level is null), its typed manifest is cross-checked against the sealed bundle, the hash-bound evidence file, the audited end-of-line tolerances, the bound section and the claim matrix by the screening checker in check_paper.py, and it never opens GATE-L1.

gates.title: Preregistered robust multi-objective optimisation of the L0 model under declared cusp-probability uncertainty, campaign v1
gates.kind_justification: The numerical-campaign kind admits one accepted, preregistered numerical campaign about a declared component model. Here the component model is the accepted L0 conservation model (cft_revival.physics, L0-conservation-reduced-performance) evaluated under the declared multiplicative cusp-survival closure CL-1 and declared uniform priors, and the campaign is one accepted single execution (8 of 8 binding gates, terminal state accepted_result). The kind therefore fits and is reused with its own typed manifest, evidence file, macro-only section, claim records and campaign checker. The campaign is optimiser evidence (hypervolume per budget, paired comparisons, seed variance, Pareto sizes, robust-versus-nominal fronts, sensitivity to the cusp prior), not performance evidence: it makes no thruster-performance, plasma or physical-device claim, contains no field solve, geometry variable or L0 mapping, and opens none of GATE-L1, GATE-L2 or GATE-L3.
